card.name: The word oral in hydration and solutions
card.fires_on: The word "oral" (also "Oral", "mouth", or the start of "Orally") meaning by-mouth intake. It appears in phrases like oral hydration, oral solution, oral intake and oral activated charcoal.

modes.label: Oral intake or hydration
modes.description: "oral" follows a word like adequate, decreased or inadequate and refers to fluid or food taken by mouth.

modes.label: Oral solution or oral drug form
modes.description: "oral" follows "for" in a dosage-form name, or opens a treatment line such as oral activated charcoal.
modes.example: sodium bicarbonate and potassium chloride for<< oral>> solution, supplied as a powder, must

modes.description: The route is written as "mouth" or as the start of "Orally".
